question: Unsa ang dugang requirements sa OCBO kung 3-storey pataas ang building nga itukod?
answer: Sa iyong kahibawan, ang mga requirements sa OCBO (Office of the City Building Official) kung 3-storey pataas ang building nga itukod ay nakatanggap ka nga requirement sa Pavement Permit. Ang Pavement Permit ay kailangan bago mag-start ang proyekto at construction. Ang mga requirements sa Pavement Permit ay maaari mo makita sa [S3]. Ang mga requirements sa Pavement Permit ay 3 sets ng form na Civil/Arch. [S3, DEV120-OCBO-PDF0043-C001]

ground_truth: Conditional requirements state: construction/minor repair of buildings 3 storeys and above requires Construction Safety & Health Program, 1 original and 1 photocopy, with DOLE listed under Where to Secure. Boring and Plate Load Test Result/Report is listed if the structure is at least three storeys, 2 copies, with a licensed Civil/Geotechnical Engineer listed. For an additional storey, submit an affidavit that the foundation can carry the proposed additional floors, 2 originals.
